{{Top}}
'''Nova Demons''' was the name of a [[Swooper/Legends|swoop biker]] [[Swoop gang/Legends|gang]] that utilized [[Flare-S swoop/Legends|Flare-S swoops]] as vehicle mounts. The Nova Demons operated on a handful of [[Planet/Legends|planets]] near [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]].
[[File:SWOO01AB.jpg|thumb|250px|A Nova Demons gang member's swoop bike]]
